relevance_note: Family case report of LAMP2-positive Danon disease: 'a hemizygous c.573delA variant was identified in exon 5 of LAMP2' in the proband, and 'Both of his sisters were heterozygous for this deletion'.
method_note: Read the paper in full and built the JSON with a short Python script in the scratch directory; all values typed from my reading. In scope: proband (II 2), elder sister (II 1), younger sister (no own label), mother (affected, DCM, not genotyped: 'DNA was not available'; the paper only says she was 'likely' a carrier, so no variant row) and father (tested negative, no variant row, no features stated in text; 'unaffected' status appears only in the pedigree image). Table 1 lists previously reported mutations per publication, not individuals, so no rows were made from it. Proband age: abstract says 18 years old, case report says admitted as a 17-year-old (Fig 2 at 17 years); I used 18 as age at report, consistent with heart failure emerging at 18. Sister ages taken from '2 sisters (15 and 20 years old)', assigned by elder/younger (20 to the elder, 15 to the younger), not by position. Proband's HCM diagnosis at 5 years recorded as onset, not as age at diagnosis of Danon disease (not stated). Normal acid maltase and alpha-galactosidase activity recorded as excluded reduced activity (D-27). 'Normal intelligence' excludes intellectual disability as a feature row, but the composite checklist item (includes learning difficulties) left not reported. Younger sister's ECG abnormalities are only 'suggestive of' WPW, so the pre-excitation checklist item is left not reported. 'Obstructive HCM' taken as LVOT obstruction for the checklist. No PVCs on Holter does not exclude VT/VF. Functional analysis: 'has not been performed' for this mutation, so functional_evidence_statement is not reported. Inheritance not reported for all carriers: father negative, mother untested. No internal contradictions found.
